title: Lab-Grown Import Monitor, September 2026
description: A reproducible monthly series on United States imports of cut laboratory-grown diamonds. The primary series uses US Census Bureau HTS 7104.91.10.00 data through July 2026 and is cross-checked against UN Comtrade HS 710491 data through June 2026. The edition includes source notes, methodology, caveats, tables, scripts, and charts. Customs value is not represented as retail price or a quality-adjusted price index.
